title: Agent Bots Marching
style: Big-band rap march with fast boom-bap energy and swung snare kicks; verse rides tight internal-rhyme rap over bass brass hits, pre-hook strips to snare, tuba, and chant, chorus slams with gang vocals, call-and-response, and sharp brass stabs. Vocal stack uses shouted doubles, crowd responses in parentheses, and short delay throws on anchor phrases. Ear candy: snare rolls into each hook, trumpet fanfare lifts, and a final brass break under the chant. Bright, punchy, and stadium-loud., light, big band, refined, bright, rap, world, happy, clean, strong, noise
